Args: author_id: Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading: Title of the post. content: Main body of the post. labels: List of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing the XSS‑protected HTML. """ # Escape all user‑supplied data to prevent injection safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Wrap each label in a and escape the label text safe_labels = "" for tag in labels: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_labels += f'{escaped_tag} ' # Strip trailing space safe_labels = safe_labels.strip() # Format the final HTML using the provided template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels )
